Data-region states

Every data region has four designed states (ui-states skill): pending = layout-matched skeleton (data-skeleton, aria-busy, shown after 150 ms); refreshing = content stays, dimmed to 60% with a small “Updating…” (filters, month pickers, refetch); error = inline card with the API message and Retry when there is no data yet (with data on screen: keep it and show an error toast); empty = one primary action. Success fades in ≤ 150 ms.
